messages:
maria: Hey team — seeing a bunch of GPU inference nodes in prod-edge-us-west2 marked UNHEALTHY in the ALB target group since ~03:12 UTC. 502s from customers.

Derek: noticed during the rollout. Target group shows "connection refused" to nodePorts.

Samir: can you paste `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` for an affected node and its node SG?

maria: node ip 10.12.8.43, sg: sg-0a1b2c3d (gpu-worker-prod). Pod health probe `/healthz` returns 200 locally but ALB probes fail.

maria: ALB health checks come from ALB subnet IPs to the nodePort. Pod is healthy but node refuses the external probe.

Derek: ssh to node and run `sudo iptables -L -n -v` and `curl <node-ip>:<nodePort>` from jump host?

maria: `iptables` looks default, but `curl <nodeIp>:<nodePort>` from jump host -> connection refused.

ops-bot: [automated] aws-ebs-backup completed for vol-12345

Samir: checked ENI: `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=private-ip-address,Values=10.12.8.43` -> attached to sg-0a1b2c3d and subnet private-edge-subnet-a. NACL allows ephemeral ports. SG inbound only allows 1024-65535 from sg-api-proxies and 443 from sg-alb-nat, outbound restricted to 443 to internal CIDRs.

maria: outbound being restricted is suspicious — ALB probes are inbound to nodePort but ALB is not using the sg-api-proxies SG. Our autoscaler/lambda usually tags instances and provisioning ensures correct SG; if tag missing it attached default SG with restrictive egress.

Derek: observed autoscale launched nodes missing tag `kubernetes.io/cluster/redwood-prod=shared`. Provisioner lambda sees the tag, otherwise falls back to default sg.

maria: repro: new node without cluster tag gets default SG -> LB probes fail -> target unhealthy. Manual fix: swapped SG on ENI to sg-0a1b2c3d-fixed and drained/uncordoned node, health returned.

Samir: temp fix commands:
```
aws ec2 modify-network-interface-attribute --network-interface-id eni-0bbfd123 --groups sg-0a1b2c3d-fixed
kubectl drain ip-10-12-8-43 --ignore-daemonsets && kubectl uncordon ip-10-12-8-43
```

maria: applied on ~6 nodes, unhealthy count down from 42 -> 2. Proposing permanent fixes:
- update autoscaling lambda to set `kubernetes.io/cluster/redwood-prod=shared` tag at launch
- patch launch template to attach correct SG based on instance-role metadata
- add unit/integration tests for tag-based SG assignment

Derek: also add inbound rule on gpu-worker-prod SG to allow ALB SG (`sg-alb-xxxx`) instead of relying on egress relax.

maria: opened INFRA-3421 with logs & node list. I'll patch the LT and schedule drain/replace in maintenance window. :thumbsup:

Samir: I'll coordinate staging canary: update LT there first and verify ENI gets correct SG and ALB probes pass. Also add E2E check in deploy pipeline that asserts `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces` returns the expected SG and `nc -vz <node-ip> <nodePort>` from ALB subnet succeeds.

ops-bot: [reminder] maintenance window scheduled 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC

Jen: oncall ACK, I'll be available during window.

maria: will post updates here during the rollout.

Jen: thanks — keep us posted.
